name: Interacting with Objects
desc: A creature can interact with one object or feature of the environment for free during its move or action — drawing a sword, opening an unlocked door, handing an item to another creature, or pulling a lever. Interacting with a second object in the same turn requires the Use an Object action. Some objects always take an action to use, as noted in their description. When a character tries to do something with an object that the rules don't cover, the GM decides whether it is possible and whether a check is required.
